2025 PFN Team Preview: The Upper Perkiomen Indians
By Jason Napoli,
1 days agoOur football program and culture has grown a lot in 2024. We need to focus as a team on the little things and find player-driven leadership to extend our season further than we have before. With the senior class coming back that we have, we need their absolute best as a class and the leadership they can provide to take us where WE want to be. Our expectations are to far-exceed those from last year and go beyond a playoff birth and win our division in the PAC and win a PAC title. The things we see as goals have not happened at Upper Perk for over 2 decades. The work comes before the opportunity though, so this summer and upcoming summer camp need to be the best this program has had in a long time. We are excited for the opportunity to be great this year and find ourselves getting better week in and week out. Our OC this year, Zeke Hallman is a former QB here at Upper Perk and has the ability to really add a new spark in our offense. We are excited to rally around him and get the ball in numerous weapons hands this season. We have the tools to be good, our job now is to turn that potential into success. We have some new faces on staff that really bring fresh new ideas along with guys who know our goals and expectations. However, every good program is lead from within and we need our seniors to step up and demand more from within. I believe they will rise to the challenge.
